channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
item.description: Bringing fast and capable computer use to everyone

item.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
item.description: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases. Its security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.

item.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
item.description: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.

item.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
item.description: Explore OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how people use ChatGPT for work and how usage changes over time.

item.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
item.description: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
item.description: GPT-6.1 Terra, OpenAI’s newest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for everyday agentic coding and terminal work at a lower cost than GPT-6.1 Sol.

item.title: Introducing Agent Skills
item.description: Claude can now use Skills to improve how it performs specific tasks. Skills are folders that include instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude can load when needed. Claude will only access a skill when it's relevant to the task at hand.

item.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Fine-tune Claude 3 Haiku in Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Claude 3 Haiku can now be fine-tuned in Amazon Bedrock with custom training data, enabling faster, more accurate performance at lower cost. Update: Fine-tuning Claude 3 Haiku in Amazon Bedrock is generally available.

item.title: Announcements
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
item.description: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

item.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
item.description: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

item.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
item.description: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are partnering on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem.

item.title: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports. A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.

item.title: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
item.description: The new GitHub app in Teams brings notifications and Copilot together, helping teams turn issues into fixes and ship code faster without leaving the conversation. Get notified in channels, group chats, or private chats, then @mention GitHub to turn updates into action.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — September update
item.description: September 2026 brought deeper visibility into your work: explore pull requests without leaving chat, bring the AI model your team trusts, and fix vulnerable packages the moment Visual Studio flags them. Highlights Here’s what’s new with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.

item.title: experimental-claude-tag-2026-10-21
item.description: The Claude Tag API is available in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations with the experimental-claude-tag-2026-10-21 beta header. Its /v1/organizations/claude_tag/ endpoints read and change Claude Tag settings on Slack channels and Slack workspaces, show which settings apply in a channel and where each comes from, and attach Access bundles. Call it with an Admin API key that your primary owner creates in claude.ai with the read:claude_tag or write:claude_tag scope.

item.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
item.description: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees, helping teams research, analyze data, create presentations, and complete complex workflows.

item.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
item.description: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.

item.title: Decisions API, changes since public beta
item.description: The Decisions API is now generally available with gpt-6-luna. Cache shared input across requests for prompt-cache discounts, include images in individual question instructions, and pass structured data directly with input_json.

item.title: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
item.description: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes an “Industry comparison” section. Enterprises, and organizations that aren’t owned by an enterprise, can compare their Copilot agentic adoption and leverage with aggregated benchmarks from participating peers.

item.title: Global default for Copilot features generally available
item.description: In September, we announced a global default policy for generally available GitHub Copilot features and supported client capabilities on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans. Starting today, we’re gradually rolling out enforcement of the policy through October 26, so it may take effect at different times for different enterprises and organizations.

item.title: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in usage metrics API
item.description: Copilot usage metrics now show the names of the skills, custom agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, slash commands, and plugins that your organization creates, instead of grouping them under other or custom. This builds on the agentic CLI customization metrics released in September.

item.title: Product
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
item.description: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.

item.title: Fast mode
item.description: Fast mode is available for Claude Opus 5.5 on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed).

item.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed)
item.description: We've launched Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), the Claude API operated by Anthropic and reached through your Google Cloud project. Google Cloud IAM controls access. Google Cloud Marketplace handles billing.

item.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
item.description: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

item.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

item.title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
item.description: OpenAI outlines a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders with frontier AI, stronger safeguards, modernized cybersecurity, and more resilient public institutions.

item.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
item.description: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

item.title: Cloudflare links vulnerability discovery to defense with OpenAI
item.description: Cloudflare uses OpenAI Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities and propose fixes for review. Its developers use Codex to build faster and improve code quality.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
item.description: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

item.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
item.description: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

item.title: Broad access through consistent standards
item.description: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

item.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
item.description: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

item.title: enforcement_status
item.description: We've added the enforcement_status and enforcement_actions fields to user profiles, so you can see whether Anthropic has restricted or banned one of your end customers. To find the profiles that have an open restriction or ban, list your profiles with the new enforcement_status[] filter. See Check whether Anthropic has restricted or banned a profile.

item.title: ant
item.description: We've released new versions of the client SDKs and the ant CLI that send API version 2026-10-21 by default: Python SDK 2.0.0, TypeScript SDK 1.0.0, C# SDK 13.0.0, Go SDK 2.0.0, Java SDK 3.0.0, PHP SDK 1.0.0, Ruby SDK 2.0.0, and ant CLI 2.0.0. See Switch to 2026-10-21.
We've released API version 2026-10-21. Migrating to API version 2026-10-21 shows how to upgrade.

item.title: SDK and CLI changes
item.description: The new SDK and CLI versions also have breaking changes that don't depend on the API version, and they are licensed under Apache 2.0 instead of the MIT License. See SDK and CLI changes.

item.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
item.description: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement. He has also advised the US government on national security and arms control. “I am honored to join Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust and to help the company deliver on its public benefit mission,” said Stubbs.

item.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
item.description: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
item.description: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

item.title: You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API.
item.description: You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API. 12-hour prompt caching keeps shared instructions, tools, and context cached longer to benefit from lower cached-input pricing, even when requests are hours apart.

item.title: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description: Editor’s note (October 21, 2026): Rewrote the changelog for clarity and added imagery. There’s been a recent flood of malware attacks that exploit systems at package installation time.

item.title: webhooks-2026-10-07
item.description: We've added organization webhooks to the Admin API, in beta with the webhooks-2026-10-07 beta header. Its /v1/organizations/webhooks endpoints register webhook endpoints for two event types: one for when Anthropic restricts or bans one of your organization's user profiles, and one for when the restriction or ban ends. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.

item.title: Inference hooks
item.description: Inference hooks are out of beta for Claude Enterprise organizations.

item.title: Capabilities
item.description: Organization admins can now turn off web fetch for their organization on the Capabilities page of the Claude Console. With web fetch off, a Messages API request that includes the web fetch tool fails with a 400 error. In a Claude Managed Agents session, web_fetch calls return an error result to the agent instead. With web fetch on, admins can also set allowed or blocked domains for web fetch on the same page. See How to use web fetch and Domain filtering.

item.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
item.description: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.
